About CDL Entry-Level Driver Training (ELDT)

CDL Entry-Level Driver Training (ELDT): 8 self-paced online courses from $49.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Who delivers the training

Every course on CDL Entry-Level Driver Training (ELDT) is delivered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC on its online learning portal at hazwoper-osha.com. When you enroll here, your order goes to hazwoper-osha.com and your course login arrives by email right after payment.
